about.text: Raw milk kept from spoiling without a cold chain by switching on its own lactoperoxidase with a little thiocyanate and hydrogen peroxide, which holds back bacteria for some hours at ambient temperature on the way to a collection centre. Used where milk cannot be cooled, as in Mali.
